svg.title: Meet the Records — guided tutorial figure
svg.desc: Which parts of a customer row identify and describe it? A key identifies the record: CustomerID: 130; Used to link customer records. A name describes the customer: Jones, Richardson and Beard; CustomerName. A segment classifies it: Design Trade; CustomerSegment
